pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/_insight/read.ts:127 Takes are scored 1-10 on fixed dimensions per kind (music: melody, instrument_choice, instrument_quality), and the take's own word commitments (terms.instrument, negative, mood) never become pass/fail/unmeasured check items, so the listen measures taste instead of brief conformance.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/_insight/read.ts:127 The rubric dimensions come from @gt/ui rubric.ts RUBRIC[kind] and are the same for every take. They are not derived from the brief, and RubricTake carries no terms or negative, so named inclusions and exclusions are never checked item by item.

app/(studio)/audio/_insight/read.ts:114 Tempo, key and length asked are checked by tool against the ingest measure, with held, missed, octave, unmeasured and unasked kept apart. Section boundaries and ending shape are not checked, but this batch brief commits no sections.

packages/ui/src/components/audio/strengths.ts:189 The anchor is off-context: it is the claimDraft that Strengths.tsx calls. Each provider × facet cell carries its top classified defect (lib/sound/types.ts DEFECTS mirrors the taxonomy) into the signed lesson, which is the recurrence rule's record of which brief–model pair buys which defect.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/audio/_hunt/Hunt.tsx:6 The technique says listens that compare takes need levels matched to each other before judging. No gain or LUFS matching exists in the audition path, even though the measures table holds lufs per take.
